name: Read original Immortal Blood twice and save native book progression/history

files.content:
replace=config
replace=data
resources="{resources}"
data="{oblivion_data}"
content=Oblivion.esm
start=ImperialDungeon01
skip-menu=1
new-game=0
no-grab=1
user-data="{output}/userdata"
data-local="{output}/test-data"
content=tutorial-passage-observer.omwscripts

[Video]
resolution x = 640
resolution y = 360
fullscreen = false
framerate limit = 60
[General]
screenshot format = png

[Input]
enable controller = true

[GUI]
controller menus = true

[Input]
camera sensitivity = 0.5

local self=require('openmw.self')
local types=require('openmw.types')
local core=require('openmw.core')
local nearby=require('openmw.nearby')
local util=require('openmw.util')
local camera=require('openmw.camera')
local t=-3;local path=nil;local step=2;local attempts=0
local goal=util.vector3(53926.62890625,86135.5390625,412.11285400390625)
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 t=t+dt;if t<.2 then return end;t=0
 assert(not types.Actor.isDead(self),'Player died approaching original Immortal Blood')
 local delta=goal-self.position;local distance=math.sqrt(delta.x*delta.x+delta.y*delta.y)
 local reached=distance<85 and (camera.getPosition()-goal):length()<180
 if reached then print('VilverinContinue Book arrived') end
 local target
 if reached then
  local book=nearby.getObjectByFormId(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x66cc1));assert(book and book:isValid(),'Original Immortal Blood missing')
  target=book:getBoundingBox().center
 elseif distance<250 then target=goal
 else
  if not path then
   local status,p=nearby.findPath(self.position,goal,{{agentBounds=types.Actor.getPathfindingAgentBounds(self),destinationTolerance=70}})
   print('VilverinContinue Book path status='..tostring(status)..' count='..#p)
   if #p<2 then return end;path=p;step=2;attempts=attempts+1;assert(attempts<20,'Book approach repeatedly partial')
  end
  while step<=#path do local d=path[step]-self.position;if math.sqrt(d.x*d.x+d.y*d.y)<60 and math.abs(d.z)<110 then step=step+1 else break end end
  if step>#path then path=nil;return end
  target=path[step]
 end
 local v=target-self.position;local f=self.rotation:apply(util.vector3(0,1,0))
 local yaw=math.atan2(f.y*v.x-f.x*v.y,f.x*v.x+f.y*v.y);local pitch=-camera.getPitch()
 if reached then
  local p=camera.getViewTransform():apply(target);yaw=math.atan2(p.x,-p.z);pitch=-math.atan2(p.y,math.sqrt(p.x*p.x+p.z*p.z))
  local origin=camera.getPosition();local ray=nearby.castRenderingRay(origin,origin+camera.viewportToWorldVector(util.vector2(.5,.5))*2000,{{ignore=self}})
  if ray.hitObject==nearby.getObjectByFormId(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x66cc1)) and math.abs(yaw)<.02 and math.abs(pitch)<.02 then print('VilverinContinue Book facing') end
 end
 print(string.format('VilverinContinue Book aim x=%d y=%d',math.max(-150,math.min(150,math.floor(yaw*256+.5))),math.max(-100,math.min(100,math.floor(pitch*256+.5)))))
 if math.abs(yaw)<.06 then print('VilverinContinue Book path facing') end
 print('VilverinContinue Book sample pos='..tostring(self.position)..' health='..types.Actor.stats.dynamic.health(self).current..' distance='..distance..' handtohand='..types.NPC.stats.skills.handtohand(self).base)
end}}}}
